title: Clinical Feasibility of Long-Read WGS for DNA Methylation Signature Analysis.
authors: Hildonen, Mathis; Mariani, Luca; Dalsberg, Jonas; Bak, Mads; Weksberg, Rosanna; Choufani, Sanaa; Tumer, Zeynep
one_liner_zh: 该文评估长读长测序在DNA甲基化签名临床诊断中的可行性，虽涉及表观遗传标记但非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且方法为测序与SVM分类，无AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: DNA methylation (DNAm) signatures have emerged as valuable diagnostic biomarkers for rare genetic disorders. To date, the most widely used approach for establishing and validating these signatures has relied on array-based technologies. However, in clinical diagnostics, there is a growing shift from short-read sequencing (SRS) toward long-read sequencing (LRS) technologies. Recent advances in platforms such as Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) and Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) enable direct assessment of DNAm from native DNA, offering improved resolution and reduced technical bias compared to array-based technologies. In this study, we compared DNAm profiles generated by LRS with those obtained from DNAm arrays. DNAm profiles of two individuals with pathogenic KMT2D variants were analyzed using DNAm arrays, LRS using PacBio and ONT, and ONT multiplexed sequencing with adaptive sampling. A support vector machine (SVM) classifier trained on array data, as well as the public classification platform EpigenCentral, yielded correct predictions for all LRS samples, underscoring the potential of LRS platforms in DNAm-based diagnostics. Our results suggest that DNAm profiles generated by LRS align well with DNAm signatures established using DNAm arrays, supporting their feasibility in clinical and research applications with the added benefit of simultaneous methylation and sequence analysis.
abstract_zh: DNA甲基化（DNAm）特征已成为罕见遗传疾病有价值的诊断生物标志物。迄今为止，建立和验证这些特征最广泛使用的方法依赖于基于阵列的技术。然而，在临床诊断中，正逐渐从短读长测序（SRS）转向长读长测序（LRS）技术。Pacific Biosciences（PacBio）和Oxford Nanopore Technologies（ONT）等平台的最新进展使得能够直接从天然DNA评估DNAm，与基于阵列的技术相比，提供了更高的分辨率和更少的技术偏差。在本研究中，我们比较了由LRS生成的DNAm谱与从DNAm阵列获得的DNAm谱。对两名携带致病性KMT2D变异个体的DNAm谱，分别使用DNAm阵列、PacBio和ONT的LRS，以及带自适应采样的ONT多重测序进行了分析。基于阵列数据训练的支持向量机（SVM）分类器以及公共分类平台EpigenCentral，对所有LRS样本均给出了正确预测，凸显了LRS平台在基于DNAm的诊断中的潜力。我们的结果表明，由LRS生成的DNAm谱与使用DNAm阵列建立的DNAm特征高度一致，支持其在临床和研究应用中的可行性，并具有同时进行甲基化和序列分析的额外优势。
